<!-- Generated by scripts/docs_programs.py from the man pages; edit those. -->
The programs in mcos's `/bin`. Each page is the program's man page: the same text `man <name>` shows in the game. See [the shell](/mcos/shell/) for how to run them.

| Program | What it does |
|---|---|
| [aplay](/programs/aplay/) | play WAV files on a sound card |
| [cat](/programs/cat/) | concatenate files and print them |
| [clear](/programs/clear/) | clear the terminal screen |
| [cp](/programs/cp/) | copy files and directories |
| [curl](/programs/curl/) | make an HTTP request |
| [date](/programs/date/) | print the date and time |
| [df](/programs/df/) | report file system space usage |
| [dmesg](/programs/dmesg/) | print the kernel's log |
| [du](/programs/du/) | estimate file space usage |
| [echo](/programs/echo/) | display a line of text |
| [edit](/programs/edit/) | a simple text editor, after nano |
| [efibootmgr](/programs/efibootmgr/) | show and change the EEPROM's boot entries and boot order |
| [false](/programs/false/) | do nothing, unsuccessfully |
| [find](/programs/find/) | search for files in a directory tree |
| [free](/programs/free/) | display the amount of memory in use and free |
| [grep](/programs/grep/) | print lines that match a pattern |
| [halt](/programs/halt/) | stop the computer |
| [head](/programs/head/) | output the first part of files |
| [hostname](/programs/hostname/) | show or set the host's name |
| [kill](/programs/kill/) | send a signal to a process |
| [label](/programs/label/) | show or set a device's label |
| [less](/programs/less/) | show text a screen at a time |
| [ln](/programs/ln/) | make links between files |
| [ls](/programs/ls/) | list directory contents |
| [lsdev](/programs/lsdev/) | list the devices on the bus |
| [lua](/programs/lua/) | Lua interpreter |
| [man](/programs/man/) | show a manual page |
| [mkdir](/programs/mkdir/) | make directories |
| [mktemp](/programs/mktemp/) | make a file or directory with a unique name |
| [mount](/programs/mount/) | list or mount filesystems |
| [mv](/programs/mv/) | move or rename files |
| [nc](/programs/nc/) | send and receive over TCP or UDP |
| [poweroff](/programs/poweroff/) | turn the computer off |
| [ps](/programs/ps/) | list the processes |
| [rc](/programs/rc/) | start, stop and enable services |
| [rcp](/programs/rcp/) | copy files between computers |
| [reboot](/programs/reboot/) | restart the computer |
| [resize](/programs/resize/) | set or show the terminal's size |
| [rm](/programs/rm/) | remove files and directories |
| [rmdir](/programs/rmdir/) | remove empty directories |
| [rsh](/programs/rsh/) | run a command or a shell on another computer |
| [rshd](/programs/rshd/) | the remote shell's daemon |
| [sh](/programs/sh/) | the shell |
| [sleep](/programs/sleep/) | wait for a time |
| [stty](/programs/stty/) | show or change the terminal's line settings |
| [tail](/programs/tail/) | output the last part of files |
| [time](/programs/time/) | time a command |
| [touch](/programs/touch/) | make empty files |
| [tree](/programs/tree/) | list directories as a tree |
| [true](/programs/true/) | do nothing, successfully |
| [umount](/programs/umount/) | unmount filesystems |
| [uptime](/programs/uptime/) | tell how long the computer has been running |
| [wget](/programs/wget/) | download a file from the internet |
| [yes](/programs/yes/) | output a line again and again |
